`CalendarEventDialogRoute` owns scheduling, cancellation/supersession, generation tracking, and show gating; `CalendarEventDialogSourceMixin` owns route attributes, Redux observation, and lifecycle hooks. Extend selectors with static `getCalendarEventDialogStateSelectors(sessionKey)` and call `applyInitialState()` after subclass DOM setup. [Task 2]
